|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once during your control phase , if opponent occupies a non-battleground location, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand. Once per game, may exchange one card in opponent's Lost Pile with a card on their Colo Claw Fish.[Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[For Luck (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once during your control phase, if opponent occupies a non-battleground location, may peek at top two cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “phase ,” → “phase,”; removed “the”; “Once per game, may exchange one card in opponent's Lost Pile with a card on their Colo Claw Fish.[Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 9. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[For Luck]].
* Later text: [[For Luck (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
